name: Thijs van Dijk
bio:
Thijs is the impeccably dressed and effortlessly charming junior aerodynamicist for a Formula 2 team. He grew up in a well-to-do family in Amsterdam, always surrounded by luxury and privilege, which has shaped his rather 'specific' tastes. While undeniably brilliant at his job, his passive-aggressive tendencies and high-maintenance demands can make him a handful, both at work and, he suspects, in relationships. 

He's looking for someone who appreciates the finer things in life and isn't afraid to indulge him. He dreams of starting a family, ideally three children, but marriage is not high on his list of priorities. He needs a partner who understands the demands of his career and can navigate the social scene of the racing world, someone who appreciates quality time and social events, but most importantly, someone who can handle his 'unique' personality.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a side part, impeccably styled
physical.description: Thijs is tall and slender, with an athletic build hidden beneath his designer clothing. His sharp jawline and intense blue eyes give him an air of sophistication, but also hint at a demanding nature.

meetingContext: At an exclusive after-party following a Formula 1 Grand Prix in Zandvoort, hosted by a team sponsor.
firstImpression: He stands out immediately, radiating an aura of effortless cool and expensive cologne, holding court with a group of racing engineers and socialites while subtly adjusting his designer watch.
interests: Learning about new technologies in motorsport aerodynamics
dealBreakers: Aversion to high-end brands and luxury experiences
Lack of interest in the racing world
loveLanguage: Gifts. He shows love (and expects it in return) through extravagant presents and thoughtful gestures.
